step.action: Put unattended personal belongings in 🍷 Lost_and_Found.
Brush crumbs and dry debris into 🍷 Dustpan_and_Brush.
Put the collected debris in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Inspect the bar top for sticky or visible residue.
step.ifThen: IF residue is present, THEN do steps 5 through 7. IF none remains, THEN skip to step 8.

step.action: Wipe each sprayed spot with 🍷 Disposable_Towels until the residue is gone.
Put remaining MOOP from the bar top and floor in 📦 Trash_Bins.

passWhen.criterion: No unattended belonging, crumb, trash, MOOP, sticky spot, or visible residue remains.
The bar top is dry and ready for service.
